ctx.x: Yeah, I met Benny Bailey. But he wasn't playing like he can play now. I was surprised to hear him when I went to Europe. He stretched out a little bit more. Because when I first met him, he was like a timid young fellow. But he knows more about the trumpet now than he did then.
But that's the way it went. So we went into the club, and shortly after that... I mean, I had a ball...
